headline: Continued review of 2027 grant applications.
summary: This special extended session is for reviewing 2027 grant applications. Minutes from September and November 2026 are also listed for a vote.
location: City Hall Annex, 98 Washington St. 1st Floor Large Conference Room, Salem MA 01902, and Zoom
plain_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING 
 Salem Cultural Council 
 Monday, December 7, 2026 at 6:00 pm 
 City Hall Annex, 98 Washington St. 1 st Floor 
 Large Conference Room 
 Hybrid Meeting 
 Important Announcement 
 In accordance with Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021, and as amended by Chapter 22 of the Acts 
 of 2022, this meeting of the Salem Cultural Council will be conducted via hybrid participation. 
 Specific information and the general guidelines for remote participation by members of the 
 public and/or parties with a right and/or requirement to attend this meeting can be found below. 
 In-Person Participation Instructions: 
 Arrive at City Hall Annex, 98 Washington St., Salem MA 01902. Enter the front doors and look 
 for signs directing you to the 1st Floor Medium Conference Room across from the restrooms 
 near the rear exit. 
 Remote Participation Instructions: 
 Public participation for the Salem Cultural Council meeting scheduled for Monday November 
 2nd at 6:00pm will be conducted via a free remote participation platform called Zoom. 
 The City of Salem strongly encourages any parties who wish to participate in this meeting to 
 download and familiarize themselves with Zoom prior to the meeting. 
 For this meeting, members of the public who wish to watch, listen or provide comment during 
 the meeting may do so using one of the following methods: 
 ▪ Video & Audio Option 1: Follow this link or enter it into your web browser to join the 
 meeting: 
 https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88612521046?pwd=KZzIRSMH3bNLV2naIjV96yn7haajqh.1 
 ▪ Video & Audio Option 2: Follow this link or enter it into your web browser to open the 
 Zoom website at https://zoom.us/join or open your Zoom App on your smart device.
Then enter the  Meeting ID# 886 1252 1046  as directed on the webpage and click “Join”. 
 Follow the on-screen instructions to join the meeting. Meeting Password is  SCC  . 
 ▪ Audio ONLY – Dial 888-475-4499 (or 877-853-5257 if trouble connecting, both are Toll 
 Free) to join the meeting using your phone. When prompted, enter  Meeting ID# 886 
 1252 1046  and follow the instructions to join the meeting. Meeting Password is  SCC  . 
 Public Comment Protocol: 
 NOTE  :  No public calls or comments shall be taken at this meeting  , due to it being a 
 special extended meeting for the council to review 2027 grant applications. 
 More detailed instructions for asking questions and other meeting protocols are available at 
 https://www.salem.com/salem-cultural-council and will be reviewed at the start of the meeting. 
 MEETING AGENDA 
 Monday, December 7, 2026 
 1.  Roll Call. 
 2.  Prior Meeting Minutes Vote (September 2026 and November 2026). 
 3.  Continue 2027 grant application reviews. 
 4.  Any other business. 
 5.  Adjourn. 
 Contacts: 
 Ian M. McCelestine, Council Co-Chair 
 Cris Gladly, Council Co-Chair, Treasurer 
 SalemCulturalCouncil@salem.com 
 Julie Barry, Council Staff Representative; Senior Planner of Arts & Culture 
 jbarry@salem.com 
 Persons requiring auxiliary aids and services for effective communication such as sign language 
 interpreter, an assistive listening device, or print material in digital format or a reasonable 
 modification in programs, services, policies, or activities, may contact the City of Salem ADA 
 Coordinator, as soon as possible and no less than 2 business days before the meeting, 
 program, or event. 
 Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A § 18-25 and City Ordinance § 
 2-2028 through § 2-2033.
